intro: Egypt is a presidential republic in which the president and army hold great power.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for six years and appoints the prime minister. Parliament has a House of Representatives and a Senate. Rights groups say critics and journalists face arrest.

chapters.title: A regional power
text: Egypt hosts the Arab League and plays a key role in talks over Gaza.

keyTerms.meaning: An organisation of Arab states based in Cairo.
